mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT container_id,container_started_at AS started_at,readiness_hash FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE id=#{environmentId} AND state='READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment SET fence=fence+1,version=version+1,last_activity_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND id=#{environmentId} AND fence=#{fence} AND version=#{version} AND state='READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_environment_use(id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,actor_id,owner_id,request_id,generation,fence, creation_command_id,creation_fence,project_id,image_id,policy_hash,container_id,container_started_at,kind,request_hash,request_text,status, lease_until,execute_until,deadline_at) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.spaceId},#{row.workspaceId},#{row.environmentId},#{row.actorId},#{row.ownerId},#{row.requestId},#{row.generation},#{row.fence}, #{row.creationCommandId},#{row.creationFence},#{row.projectId},#{row.imageId},#{row.policyHash},#{row.containerId},#{row.containerStartedAt},#{row.kind},#{row.requestHash},#{row.requestText},'CLAIMED', clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',clock_timestamp()+interval '135 seconds')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND execute_until>clock_timestamp() AND NOT cancel_requested)
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET runner_instance_id=#{runnerId},version=version+1 WHERE AND runner_instance_id IS NULL AND execute_until>clock_timestamp() AND NOT cancel_requested

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET file_execution_mode='TRUSTED_HELPER',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{command.id} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND environment_id=#{command.environmentId} AND actor_id=#{command.actorId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND runner_instance_id=#{runnerId} AND kind LIKE 'FILE_%' AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND execute_until>clock_timestamp() AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND NOT cancel_requested
mapper.select: SELECT file_execution_mode FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET exec_id=#{execId},version=version+1 WHERE AND runner_instance_id=#{runnerId} AND exec_id IS NULL AND execute_until>clock_timestamp() AND NOT cancel_requested

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment SET state='BLOCKED',error_code=#{error},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.environmentId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence}
UPDATE pf.workspace SET environment_state='BLOCKED',version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND id=#{command.workspaceId}

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment SET version=version+1,last_activity_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.environmentId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence}

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET cancel_requested=true,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND NOT cancel_requested AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_use_result r WHERE r.use_id=#{id})
UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET runner_instance_id=#{runnerId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND runner_instance_id IS NULL AND exec_id IS NULL AND status IN('CLAIMED','UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(#{stop.startedAt} AS timestamptz)<CAST(#{stop.finishedAt} AS timestamptz) AND CAST(#{stop.finishedAt} AS timestamptz)<=#{stop.observedAt} AND #{stop.observedAt}>=clock_timestamp()-interval '300 seconds' AND #{stop.observedAt}<=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace SET environment_state='STOPPED',version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND id=#{command.workspaceId}

UPDATE pf.workspace_sandbox_slot SET space_id=NULL,workspace_id=NULL,environment_id=NULL,generation=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND environment_id=#{command.environmentId} AND generation=#{command.generation}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment_use u JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.id=u.environment_id JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation o ON o.id=u.stop_operation_id JOIN pf.workspace_environment_stop_receipt r ON r.operation_id=o.id AND r.source_use_id=u.id WHERE u.id=#{command.id} AND u.space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND u.workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND u.environment_id=#{command.environmentId} AND u.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND u.generation=#{command.generation} AND u.fence=#{command.fence} AND u.status='STOPPED' AND e.operation_id=o.id AND e.state='STOPPED' AND e.generation=u.generation AND e.fence=o.fence AND o.fence>u.fence AND o.effect_origin='USE_TERMINATION' AND o.source_use_id=u.id AND o.status='COMMITTED' AND o.effect_state='STOPPED' AND o.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND o.deadline_at>clock_timestamp() AND r.exec_stopped AND r.callbacks_stopped)
